As the weather cools and the autumn outdoor activity season kicks off, I usually adjust my daily carry list to match my schedule. The Pelican MagSafe wallet and card holder is the top pick — ideal for those who want something rugged and durable that can handle the outdoors while still functioning as an everyday wallet.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers rounds up the latest and greatest MagSafe and wireless charging products to help you get the most out of your wireless-charging-compatible Apple devices.

First choice for outdoor activities

The Pelican wallet has an IPX4 water-resistance rating, meaning even if you get splashed while hiking or near water, your credit cards and cash stay dry. The wallet snaps shut securely and stays closed once fastened. For example, in autumn I often go to watch the Falcons games — even at the stadium I want to make sure everything is packed away properly. That alone makes it a perfect pick for autumn outdoor activities, especially when the weather is unpredictable. Compared with a typical magnetic wallet that sticks to the back of your phone, this feels more like a small hard-shell protective case.

Most MagSafe wallets are only designed to hold a few cards. Pelican's design is far more flexible — you can easily slip in your ID and credit cards, and there is also room for folded bills and a small key. If you want to travel light on a hike, this wallet already covers the basics, no extra bag required.

Although the Pelican wallet is主打 outdoor use, it also performs brilliantly as an everyday carry item. The strong magnets hold it firmly to the back of the iPhone, and once snapped shut nothing falls out. Compared with other, less durable MagSafe wallets, this one sacrifices a little slimness in exchange for extra peace of mind. If I want a more minimalist wallet in summer, I probably wouldn't pick it; but for hiking, watching a game, or any outdoor activity where the weather might change, it's the best choice. It's also a great MagSafe wallet for kids who just got their first iPhone — my older son has been using one for a few years now.

Pelican MagSafe wallet conclusion

The Pelican MagSafe wallet is built for those who value durability. It protects your essentials from rain and the elements, holds what you need for a hike or a day out, and stays securely closed. If you're looking for a MagSafe wallet that can take a drop and still work day in, day out, this is it.

You can buy the Pelican MagSafe wallet directly from Amazon or the Pelican website.
